answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 50454 Country: United Kingdom Title: Masah on Turban Question: If I am doing wudhu with my turban on, and I have to do masah, should I take off my turban and then do masah, or should I do masah on my forehead and over my turban? Answer ID: 50454 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 209/209/M=03/1435) Masah is not done over forehead or turban rather it is done over head. You may perform wudhu while wearing turban but while doing masah over head you should take off the turban. It is fardh to do masah over one fourth part of the head and it is sunnah to do masah over entire head. Note: Masah shall not be valid if done over the turban. (L) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
